common_shapes_comparison.description: Common Shapes: UV unwrapping with the fewest valid charts (paper Table 1, Common Shapes rows). Charts must be continuous, fold- and overlap-free and within the paper's per-chart area-distortion threshold tau = 1.25 (fixed by the evaluator). Hidden test: 12 held-out meshes run through each method's unwrap.sh.

success_rate.description: % of meshes whose output keeps the input surface and has only valid charts.

avg_charts.description: Headline metric: mean per-mesh chart count; an invalid chart counts one chart per triangle, a failed mesh one chart per input triangle.

angular_distortion.description: Mean per-mesh angular score 1 - mean|cos(tangent, bitangent)| (paper Sec. 4.1); triangles of invalid charts count |cos| = 1, failed meshes 0. Guards against trading conformality for fewer charts.

area_distortion.description: Mean per-mesh worst-chart area distortion (paper Eq. 3, triangle values clipped at 10); 10 for a mesh with an invalid chart or a failed output. Low weight: the tau = 1.25 bound is enforced per chart, so below it this mostly rewards extra charts.

common_shapes_comparison._notes: results = paper Table 1 (Common Shapes, all 24 meshes, packed atlases, the paper's own chart counting; tau is not enforced on baselines there). The gym scores 12 held-out meshes, un-packed outputs, charts from input-surface edges joined by the output's own shared vertices with equal UVs, and enforces tau = 1.25, fold- and overlap-freedom per chart on every method. The paper's baseline numbers are kept under _xatlas and _blender because they are not on the gym's scale; the 'xatlas' row only registers the gym's baseline method (no paper number to match): the gym's xatlas fails tau on 9/12 held-out meshes. Coefficients (hardening iteration): chart count dominates (paper headline); distortion is held by the hard per-chart constraints, so area/angular keep small coefficients (see HARDENING.md).
